items.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Hits Switch 2 on August 28 — And Every Other Platform Gets the Same Content for $5
items.summary: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition lands on Switch 2 Aug 28 at $79.99. PS5, Xbox and PC get the same classes, armor and Torrent skins for €4.99. All 10 details.
items.content:
AI Tech Gaming News Events Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Hits Switch 2 on August 28 — And Every Other Platform Gets the Same Content for $5 Elden Ring Tarnished Edition lands on Switch 2 Aug 28 at $79.99. PS5, Xbox and PC get the same classes, armor and Torrent skins for €4.99. All 10 details. Posted: Today Updated: Today Home > Gaming > Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Hits Switch 2 on August 28 — And Every Other Platform Gets the Same Content for $5 > FromSoftware's 2022 Game of the Year finally goes portable. Elden Ring Tarnished Edition launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on August 28, 2026 at $79.99 , bundling the base game, the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, and a batch of new gameplay and cosmetic content. Digital pre-orders are live on the eShop.

The more interesting part of this announcement isn't the port itself. It's that Bandai Namco is shipping that "new" content to PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and PC on the same day , as a €4.99 add-on called The Tarnished Pack . No exclusivity window. No six-month wait.

Three additions, all included in Tarnished Edition and all sold as the Tarnished Pack elsewhere:

Note what isn't here: no new bosses, no new region, no story content. Tarnished Edition is a definitive-bundle play, not a second expansion.

This content was built for the Switch 2 version to give the port its own identity. Selling it everywhere on day one for the price of a coffee breaks the usual re-release pattern, where fresh content gets fenced behind the newest platform to drive hardware attach.

Two numbers explain the call. Elden Ring has sold over 28 million copies on existing platforms — far too large a base to leave unmonetized while chasing a smaller one. And Switch 2 stood at 23.68 million units as of June 30, 2026. An exclusivity window would have gated the content behind a fraction of Elden Ring's existing audience.

The result is two pitches running in parallel: Switch 2 sells portability, everyone else gets a $5 nudge back into the Lands Between. Both funnel into the same discovery spike in the same week.

Pre-order buyers receive The Ring and Ring of Miquella gestures. Read the fine print: neither is a permanent exclusive — both can be earned in-game later. Pre-ordering buys convenience, not scarcity.

Physical buyers should know the Switch 2 release ships as a Game-Key Card . The cartridge is a license key and the game downloads to storage, so budget the space and don't expect a fully self-contained cart.

Is Elden Ring Tarnished Edition a sequel? No. It's the base game plus Shadow of the Erdtree plus new classes, armor and Torrent skins.

Do I need Tarnished Edition to get the new content? Only on Switch 2. On PS5, PS4, Xbox and PC, buy the Tarnished Pack for €4.99 from August 28.

Does the Tarnished Pack include Shadow of the Erdtree? No. The Pack covers classes, armor and Torrent skins only — the expansion remains a separate purchase on those platforms.

Originally released as a digital-only series, Elden Ring: Distant Tales Between will soon be offered in sleek paperbacks, perfect to add to your shelves next to your Malenia ' s figure. For fans of Elden Ring and other FromSoftware games ( Dark Souls, Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice ), this release might not come as a surprise – if you have been keeping up with the publisher, you might already know that Yen Press has released several manga adaptations of these iconic franchises, with Elden Ring: The Road to the Erdtree probably being the most recognizable of them all. And in the same vein of The Road to the Erdtree, Distant Tales Between approach to the game-to-manga adaptation is more on the lighthearted side: it keeps its narrative focused on the NPCs stories and interactions, with a strong slice-of-life component to each chapter. It’s an adaptation that doesn't take itself too seriously, but still pays homage to the source material and its intricate worldbuilding. Overall, it's a worthwhile read – while not as intense as a true-to-game adaptation DARK SOULS: REDEMPTION is, Elden Ring: Distant Tales Between manages to sneak in tidbits of lore that players might not have caught in their first playthrough of the game, enriching our understanding of the Lands Between and making it a fine adaptation to pick up as we wait for the next DLC to drop. From the publisher: What would it be like to see Roderika make friends at the Roundtable Hold…? What if a certain thieving gourmand went in search of flavors other than prawn…? What if we could go back and catch a glimpse of Raya ' s childhood in the Volcano Manor? The world of the Erdtree is vast and brimming with possibility. So come! Pull up a seat and let yourself ask " What if…? " as you follow Elden Ring ' s most beloved characters on new journeys through the Lands Between! Elden Ring: Distant Tales Between, Vol. 1 releases August 25th, 2026. Follow Yen Press on social media for updates on the latest releases.

items.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition: Release Date, Pre-Order and Platform
items.summary: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition arrives August 28, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2 at $79.99 with Shadow of the Erdtree, two new classes, new armor and Torrent customization.
items.content:
Gaming Elden Ring Tarnished Edition — 10 Things You Should Know By Brian Mazique ,

Forbes contributors publish independent expert analyses and insights. Brian Mazique has covered combat sports and video games since 2011. Follow Author Aug 17, 2026, 12:20am EDT Aug 17, 2026, 01:37am EDT --:-- / --:-- This voice experience is generated by AI. Learn more . This voice experience is generated by AI. Learn more . Summary Elden Ring is set to launch on Nintendo Switch 2 as the "Tarnished Edition" bundle on August 28, 2026. This comprehensive package, priced at $79.99, includes the acclaimed base game and the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion. Digital pre-orders are now live, offering exclusive in-game gestures. The Switch 2 version introduces new content, including two fresh starting classes, additional armor sets, and customization options for Torrent. While these features debut on Switch 2, players on PlayStation, Xbox, and PC can access them via "The Tarnished Pack" DLC, also releasing on August 28. This edition provides an all-in-one experience for fans.

Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Credit: Bandai Namco Nintendo Switch fans are about to get their Elden Ring fix. FromSoftware's open-world action RPG is coming to Switch 2 as a bundle that includes Shadow of the Erdtree and new gameplay/cosmetic content. The game launches on August 28. Digital pre-orders are live. Here's the 10 things you should know. Let's talk video games.

If you're watching the calendar, mark August 28, 2026. That's the day the Tarnished Edition drops on Switch 2.

Digital pre-orders are live on the eshop at $79.99. The physical copy is a Switch 2 Game-Key card.

While not permanently exclusive to pre-order, early adopters will get The Ring and Ring of Miquella in-game gestures.

Both gestures can also be earned later in the game.

The entire 2022 Game of the Year is included. You're charged with creating a Tarnished and exploring the Lands Between to seek the Elden Ring and become Elden Lord.

The biggest expansion in this version is the Shadow of the Erdtree. That addition brings Land of Shadow, new bosses, equipment, weapons, Ashes of War and new build options.

The Tarnished Edition adds two new starting classes to deliver fresh playthroughs.

This edition also introduces new armor. Bandai Namco hasn't given a ton of details on this front, but it should add another layer of fashion and build diversity.

Players can now customize the appearance of their Torrent. Because of how important Torrent is in the game, this is a pretty significant addition.

The added content won't stay exclusive to the Switch 2. Players on PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S and PC will be able to purchase the edition's new content separately.

Bandai Namco is selling that content as The Tarnished Pack, and it arrives on the other platforms the same day rather than later.

items.title: Rise with ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition, launching 28th August on Nintendo Switch 2
items.content:
The Lands Between—a place of myth, gods, and broken dreams. Long ago, Queen Marika and her divine offspring reigned here, but since the Elden Ring was shattered, the world has fallen into decay. Now, the land whispers for a King.

The ‘Tarnished’, long exiled, are finally seeing the light of Grace once more. Step into this hauntingly beautiful realm, unravel its ancient mysteries, and rise as the one true Elden Lord.

The ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition game arrives on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system on 28th August .

The Lands Between are part of a vast continent, where magnificent open fields and huge dungeons with complex three-dimensional designs are seamlessly connected. As you explore, the joy of discovering unknown and overwhelming threats awaits you.

Mastery of the terrain and knowledge of its secrets can help you overcome enemies and defeat formidable bosses—or lead invading players into traps.

An epic drama born from a myth created by George R.R. Martin The founding mythology of Elden Ring was written by George R. R. Martin and adapted into a rich multilayered story. Intersecting goals and desires between the characters create an intense narrative that weaves throughout the Lands Between. The events of the game can unravel in many ways—depending on your interventions.

Combat is simple to learn yet offers hidden depths of dexterity. As you seek to become the Elden Lord, you’ll need to explore the balance between attacking, avoiding damage, using a wide variety of weapons, spells, summons, and perfecting your timing to take advantage of your opponents’ weaknesses.

Create and build your own character In addition to customising the appearance of your character, there are countless ways to combine the weapons, armour, usable items, and magic that you equip. You can develop your character according to your play style.

No matter if you prefer bold physical confrontation, tactical spellcasting, or the subtle art of stealth, you’ll be able to find gear that supports your choices.

Traverse together with other Nintendo Switch 2 players. You can play with up to two other Tarnished as your cooperative teammates, either by inviting them using a shared password or by summoning them from a pool of nearby community members.

There are also ample opportunities to face off against other players, either through co-op invasions, invited duels, or the many player battle options available in the three Colosseums.

If you’d like to learn more or begin your journey to the Lands Between by pre-ordering the Tarnished Edition, please check out the link below.

items.title: The 12 Best Video Games of the 2020s (So Far), Ranked
items.summary: Dive into the best 2020s video games that offer engaging gameplay and have made their mark in their genres, from Elden Ring to Cyberpunk 2077.
items.content:
elden ring Image via FromSoftware By Robert Lee III Published Aug 16, 2026, 6:59 AM EDT Writing from the Chicagoland area in Illinois, Robert is an avid movie watcher and will take just about any excuse to find time to go to his local movie theaters. Robert graduated from Bradley University with degrees in Journalism and Game Design with a minor in Film Studies. Robert tries his best to keep up with all the latest movie releases, from those released in theaters to those released on streaming. While he doesn't always keep up with the latest TV shows, he makes it a goal to watch nearly every major new release possible. He has been honing his craft and following any and all movie news all his life, leading up to now, where he has a vast knowledge of film and film history. He also logs every movie that he watches on his Letterboxd page, and has hosted a weekly online movie night with his closest friends for over 6 years. Sign in to your Collider account Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google News Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread 2 Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Video games have grown more and more since the humble days of arcades and 8-bit consoles to be one of the most profitable and massively successful entertainment mediums in the world. With massive technological growth and an overall passion for the medium continuing to grow, it isn't exactly surprising that the video game industry has grown to be larger than the music and film industries combined. This has largely translated to the quality of video games in the 2020s being some of the best that they've ever been.

The 2020s aren't without their notable disappointments or failures in the industry, but between well-made AAA games and exceptionally passionate indie games, there is a constant stream of great video games being released year after year . The decade's best video games have proven to be some of the most well-crafted and impressive video games of all time, at the forefront of culture and pushing the medium forward in their greatness.

Screenshot from Cyberpunk 2077 Image via CD Projekt Red Few games of the 2020s had such overwhelming hype and expectation placed upon them like CD Projekt Red's Cyberpunk 2077 . After initially being announced in 2012 and following in the goodwill of their previous game, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt , Cyberpunk 2077 was being positioned as a groundbreaking masterpiece of sci-fi open-world gaming. While the game had a notoriously rough launch plagued by bugs and crashes, the game would find major improvements throughout the following years, transforming it into the sci-fi masterpiece it always wanted to be.

The core game at its center was always compelling enough to draw in fans of RPGs and sci-fi worlds alike, with a wide array of content, multiple paths and choices for the player, and an iconic supporting performance by Keanu Reeves . Without being held back by technical issues, as well as amplified by various updates and DLC expansions, the game is one of the best first-person open-world games that gaming has to offer.

Ghost-of-Tsushima-social Image via Sony Interactive Entertainment One of the last major releases by Sony on PlayStation 4, released months before the launch of the PlayStation 5, Ghost of Tsushima blends together exceptional action, a compelling story, and a vast open world to create one of the absolute best original games on PS4 . Sucker Punch Productions utilizes a lot of the inherent strengths that they built up in previous games like Infamous to create what is easily their most successful and well-made game to date.

The game makes the absolute most out of the alluring energy and striking visuals of feudal Japan, finding inspiration from classic samurai stories of the past to create what could easily be considered the most compelling and well-crafted playable samurai experience in video game history . While the game received a popular next-gen sequel in Ghost of Yotei just last year, the original Ghost of Tsushima still stands out as the fan-favorite for longtime PlayStation fans.

animal-crossing-new-horizons Image via Nintendo Few singular moments in human history felt more important and prominent for the gaming industry than the COVID-19 pandemic, as millions of people stuck at home in isolation led to many using online spaces and digital games as an escape from the pains of the real world. This ironically aligned perfectly with the release of the newest entry in the Animal Crossing series, Animal Crossing: New Horizons , whose March 20th, 2020 release was accidentally perfect timing for massive sales and importance for helping people during this rough time.

The absolute icon of cozy video games exceeds in all of the inherent strengths that made previous entries such fan favorites, only with the added elements of seamless online multiplayer and creative island building that make the game a sandbox of limitless possibilities. It quickly became one of the must-play experiences on the Nintendo Switch and one of the best-selling video games of all time , cementing its status in the annals of video game history with its success.

Kratos and Atreus standing together in God of War Ragnarok Image via Sony Interactive Entertainment 2018's God of War was a massive leap forward for the fan-favorite PlayStation franchise, adding a cinematic scope to its central story as it featured a lot of the same cathartic hack-and-slash action that made the franchise so beloved in the first place. God of War Ragnarök largely follows in a lot of the same footsteps as the previous game, with the upgrade to PS5 allowing for that much more polish and visual flair to amplify its story and gameplay.

While the previous game did a great job of setting the stage and establishing this new era for Kratos defined by fatherhood and growing beyond his painful past, Ragnarök is the captivating release of all of this buildup, as a great blend between old and new styles as he goes head-to-head with the icons of Norse mythology . Boss fights against Thor and Odin are among the best in the series, while the continued dynamic between Kratos and Atreus further grounds the game and makes it an emotionally charged force from beginning to end.

A hand of playing cards being used in a round of 'Balatro' It may seem silly to directly compare the single-developer roguelike riff on Poker to the massive AAA experiences of the modern age, but the level of polish and addictive gameplay loop of Balatro truly does place it in a league of its own in terms of indie game greatness . It's the type of game that quickly catches players off guard with its simplicity, wrapping them up into its loop of going through runs until the player looks aside and realizes hours have gone by without a second's thought.

Its inherent simplicity combined with layers of depth for more experienced players plays a central hand in its replayability, being the type of game that could seemingly be played forever and still be fun to mess around with decks in new runs. Solo dev LocalThunk truly tapped into something magical with Balatro , as even despite the wide array of roguelike indie games that were released in the 2010s and 2020s, there is nothing close to the level of polish and individuality in Balatro .

Image via Nintendo of America It feels as though each decade in gaming history is going to have its own defining The Legend of Zelda masterpiece that pushes the franchise forward and stands as a pillar of adventure games, with 2023's The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom easily fitting the bill. This ambitious sequel to one of the best games of the 2010s, The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild , manages to do the impossible by increasing the scope and scale of what was already one of the largest, most vast adventure games ever released.

Through the introduction of limitlessly creative mechanics in the Zonai devices, Tears of the Kingdom similarly invites a sense of creativity and fluidity to its gameplay that allows the player to tackle the various puzzles and combat in any which way they see fit. This, on top of the 2 additional maps above the skies and in the dark underground depths, makes it one of the most complete Zelda experiences to date.

items.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Story Spotlight Released Ahead of Nintendo Switch 2 Release
How I’m dealing with my video game backlog of 48 titles - Reader's Feature
items.summary: With too many games and not enough time to complete them all, a reader explains how he breaks down his video game backlog problem.
items.content:
With too many games and not enough time to complete them all, a reader explains how he breaks down his video game backlog problem.

My wife, who is very much into reading, is often buying new books. I commented on how many books she had yet to read and she rightly questioned how many games I’d bought that I had yet to play.

So I downloaded an app, so I could sort out my library. Frankly I’m slightly embarrassed when I started to list them in the various categories.

I’m a sucker for a new game. Currently I have 20 games on my wishlist. Amongst other things there’s GTA 6 . I’m slightly loathed to spend £70 on a digital game but it’ll be years before it drops in price and they’ll be no escaping spoilers unless you play it within the first few months of release. Although I don’t think GTA 6 will live up to the hype I think it will still be a must play game.

I’ve also got Control Resonant on the list. I don’t usually pre-order but Currys have an offer on, which drops the price to around 43 quid, which is a very reasonable price for a new game. Control is up there as one of the best games ever made and deserves more recognition. The sequel looks to be shaping up to be a worthy successor. I also want to get Toem 2 when that comes out and Zelda: Ocarina Of Time remake .

Other games that I’ll wait for a price drop are Star Wars : Galactic Racer, Moss: The Forgotten Relic, Lego Batman: Legacy Of The Dark Knight, and possibly Marvel’s Wolverine.

I’ve also started listening to a podcast called Button Boys featuring the comedians Glenn Moore, Pierre Novellie, and Sarah Keyworth and each week they recommended some lesser known games such as Killer Frequency, Expelled!, and The Dark Queen Of Mortholme and there’s a fair few I’ve added to my wishlist. Thankfully these are usually very cheap and aren’t long games.

My backlog consists of 48 games. However, 11 of these are games from bundles which I bought for other titles. Some of them, such as Amanda The Adventurer or Loddlenaut, I will likely never play. I also bought a Resident Evil bundle and some of the titles, such as Resident Evil 5 and 6 I might never get round to, but then again it was the other titles such as Resident Evil 2 remake, Resident Evil 7, and Resident Evil Village that were the main draws.

A further 27 games were free either via Epic, Steam or Amazon. Some I might play but I’m not too worried, since I didn’t pay anything. Some of the more noticeable free games are Bioshock, Disco Elysium, Dishonored, and Dredge.

Thankfully, then, only 10 of the games on my backlog I actually paid for outright. And I don’t think I paid more than £10 for any of them. Most were in the under £5 price range.

Currently I’m playing five games, which is too much really. I had started Resident Evil (the remake version from 2002) and although I was enjoying it at times the tank controls and camera angles can be a bit grating. Having never finished an Assassin’s Creed game before I bought the Black Flag remake, which I’m really enjoying. Therefore, Resident Evil went on the back burner.

I’m currently away on holiday and have only taken the Switch 2 . That means I’ve started Indiana Jones And The Great Circle. Having a good time so far, although I think Gizeh, the area I’m on at the moment, isn’t as fun to explore as the Vatican. I’ve also played a bit of Assassin’s Creed Shadows, which I enjoy but find the amount of content overwhelming, which is my issue with previous Assassin’s Creed games I’ve played. Also, whilst performance is good, the visuals look a bit blurry compared with other Switch 2 ports.

I’ve also downloaded a mobile game Bury Me, My Love which is a narrative game in the form of text messages sent to your phone about a man whose wife is escaping Syria during the war. The signal whilst I’m away is haphazard, so might have to play this more when home.

This is the real horror show. I have a whopping 22 games that I’ve paused playing. And only three are free. Another two are Game Pass games: Forza Horizon 5 and 6 – both of which I’ve played for some time but never actually completed.

items.title: Before Elden Ring launches on Switch 2 this month beat Lies of P first
items.summary: No word of a lie, it's worth your time.
items.content:
Lies of P is out now on the Nintendo Switch 2 and it deserves its flowers. Elden Ring will be great, but this is the souls game to play.

Nintendo Switch 2 owners are counting down the days until Elden Ring finally launches on the console.

It’s been many months in the making as the Elden Ring port was delayed from 2025 to this year, but will finally launch on August 28.

Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition will include the full game, plus DLC, and some new cosmetics/starter classes, which will be available as paid content packs for other platforms.

Before embarking on another quest to become Elden Lord though, consider a different souls game you can play right now on your Nintendo Switch 2, Lies of P . We’d even argue it’s better than Elden Ring in some regards.

After launching in September 2023, Lies of P has acquired quite a large fanbase, but it’s nowhere near as popular as FromSoftware’s work. Hopefully, the recently released Nintendo Switch 2 port will see it garner some new supporters, and you should be one of them.

Lies of P: Complete Edition , much like Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition , is the full game plus the DLC expansion Overture .

Combined, that’s over 55 hours of gameplay according to HowLongToBeat , if you plan on doing side-content.

My own playthroughs on the Xbox Series X and PlayStation 5 ran flawlessly and I was delighted to see the Nintendo Switch 2 version be just as good.

It felt like there was little to no sacrifice in terms of performance or visual quality despite being on Nintendo’s hardware. It just felt like good ol’ Lies of P, but this time I could take it on the go.

Bloodborne fans will get a kick out of it instantly because it’s a game that rewards a bolder playstyle. After taking damage, you can replenish a bit of your health by striking your opponent, so trading blows becomes a high-risk, high-reward strategy for melting bosses.

Lies of P will give you just as much of a challenge as some of FromSoftware’s work, and I’d argue that the Overture expansion is actually harder at times. However, if you’d rather just experience the story, past updates added difficulty modes that’ll make life a bit easier.

Elden Ring remains one of my favourite games and while I’m excited to play it on the Nintendo Switch 2 later this month, Lies of P’s re-release got me more excited.

As good as Elden Ring is, I’ve always felt its scale to have diminishing returns on repeat playthroughs. Unless I’m feeling committed, riding around the map to collect items I want for my build starts to feel like I’m shopping rather than playing a game.

items.title: What it's like beating Elden Ring twice a week for 4 years: "I think it's the greatest game that's ever been made"
items.content:
Playing FromSoftware's best RPG for a living takes you to some weird places

(Image credit: Bandai Namco) {alert('Link copied')}).catch(err => {console.error('Failed to copy: ', err)})" data-platform="copy_link" data-action="" class="font-ui-heading py-2 text-sm text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors no-underline block cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent w-full text-left normal-case" aria-label="Copy link" role="menuitem" data-analytics-id="article-social" analytics-label="utility-bar-social-share-copy-link" analytics-name="utility-bar-secondary" data-mrf-recirculation="article-social"> Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter FromSoftware is in a curious position. It released Elden Ring, its most successful and arguably best game, and ever since has exclusively released games that are very different to Elden Ring. And yes, that does include Elden Ring Nightreign, an experimental spinoff that cleverly reuses some assets and shrinks the world, then builds a PvE battle royale experience around it.

We've had Armored Core 6 and we've got The Duskbloods coming, but FromSoftware hasn't announced a new single-player dark fantasy RPG of the kind it's known for. This has left many fans revisiting the RPGs FromSoft has already released, most especially Elden Ring and its gargantuan world and DLC. It's hard to think of anybody who has gotten more out of Elden Ring than Bushy, a challenge runner who's beaten this famously long and difficult RPG over 400 times by his best estimate.

On Twitch and YouTube , Bushy is known for completing challenge runs in Elden Ring, and occasionally other games, that put restrictions on how he plays. Across hundreds of clears, he's amassed a huge collection of absurd rule sets. You have the classics, like one-hitting bosses, never dying, never getting hit, always getting hit, or kicking enemies to death. Mods, some of them commissioned by Bushy just for this purpose, also allow for stranger runs with teleportation, mismatched areas and enemies, or randomized items. Then we get to the truly specific stuff, like his most recent video: " Elden Ring But I Can Only Use White Items ".

It was this color-specific video series that pushed me to reach out to Bushy. Man , I thought, this guy has done everything . And it's easy to think that Bushy must be running out of ideas or growing sick of the game by now, but he tells me he's every bit as in love with Elden Ring as he has been for the past "3,500 to 4,000" hours of game time.

"I think it's the greatest game that's ever been made," Bushy says. "I always just have a ton of fun with it. If I didn't have that much fun with it, I wouldn't still be trying to come up with new, inventive ways to beat it. Don't get me wrong, part of that is absolutely that it's my job, and there are external forces that are encouraging me to play Elden Ring. But I think it's honestly more of a blessing than it is a curse."

7 years ago, the first Elden Ring trailer changed my life One Bloodborne player has spent 3,500 hours helping people with one of FromSoftware's hardest bosses Dark Souls isn't "an especially difficult game," former Tekken boss says The release of Elden Ring Nightreign did give Bushy some space to play another game, and the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC was a refreshing injection of new content and items, but he always comes back to the game.

He considers the pessimistic read of his position. "You could look at that in a negative light," he says. "You're playing Elden Ring because you have to, because it's the only thing that makes you money. But that's not really how I look at it. Elden Ring is a game that is big enough, massive enough, deep enough, that has such a breadth of content, that having motivation and a reason to actually play it that much is really quite the blessing. I get to play it a whole lot more than other people do."

Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more

Bushy's putting every last grain of Elden Ring under the magnifying glass. Like a speedrunner, he talks about individual bosses as things to "practice". His videos often see him deliberately rotate through spells, weapons, and items in order to explain and engage with multiple parts of the game rather than simply using the first winning option he can find, and his rule sets regularly lead to interesting discoveries about overlooked items and strategies. I'm reminded of MMO players running self-sufficient accounts, whose self-imposed challenges force them to play the game in novel ways.

His favorite challenge runs are those that dramatically change the game and are "higher effort" overall, like the one where he was teleported to a random checkpoint every five minutes. He also played the game with an aggression mod that made every enemy follow and attack him at all times, with basically no way to lose or avoid aggro. It didn't go well.

Now, Bushy can just throw out obscene sentences like this: "I've on average beaten the game probably twice a week since the game came out." This schedule wasn't immovable, but his channel history bears it out. I've learned not to underestimate FromSoftware fans, but I certainly haven't met anyone else who's rolled credits this many times. Additionally, Bushy says, "the longest I've gone not playing Elden Ring since it came out has probably been like three weeks."

Bushy is certainly looking forward to future FromSoftware games, but somehow reckons he's got more than enough Elden Ring challenge run ideas left in the tank. When he started playing the game for a living, building on years of streaming other games, he was "hopeful" after his early challenges got some attention. "I made lots of very bad videos and got more views than I had ever gotten at the time," he recalls. Elden Ring's massive audience was enough to turn the game into a career for him, not unlike how creators like VaatiVidya make a living by interpreting FromSoftware lore.

items.title: Elden Ring Is Officially Returning With A New Game
Is Elden Ring the best of the Souls series?
items.summary: Is Elden Ring the best Soulslike game ever made? Explore how FromSoftware reinvented the genre with open-world freedom, epic boss fights, and unmatched player choice.
items.content:
For over a decade FromSoftware have created an iconic system of gameplay that influenced countless other games.

For over a decade FromSoftware have created an iconic system of gameplay that influenced countless other games and inspired players of all ages.

Let’s take a look at how ELDEN RING has elevated and perfected the original Souls series formula and explore if ELDEN RING could be the best of the entire Souls series.

The majority of the games were designed by Hidetaka Miyazaki to give players the experience of exploring dark and majestic fantasy worlds full of danger.

There’s also a strong focus on difficulty, world structure, boss fights, and player builds.

The difficulty of the Souls series stems from their combat design. They emphasize deliberate attack and evasion in response to enemy movement, which tends to be quick, fierce, and punishing for players who find themselves out of position at the wrong moment. Players need to carefully observe and learn their foes’ patterns, then react to exploit certain specific attack openings without leaving themselves open as well.

This type of careful, evasive gameplay mimics the danger and strategy of real hand-to-hand combat and the high stakes keeps the tension and excitement rising in each fight. It’s not as simple as playing out a power fantasy where enemies easily fall to repeated mindless button mashing. For most players, this difficulty means that the feeling of mastering Souls series combat is a rush of pure accomplishment.

In the earlier Souls series games , levels are massive, interconnected linear paths. These paths often have several branching paths that reward exploration and puzzle solving, but are limited in terms of true open field exploration, as it’s necessary to follow a specific set order of levels, usually connected by a hub area where players can regroup, level up and open new paths, to progress throughout the game.

In the best Souls series games , carefully studying the environment and enemy behavior can lead to hidden areas or items, a particular strength of the Dark Souls series, and many players consider level design that rewards careful exploration to be a critical feature of Dark Souls-like games .

Throughout the Souls series , boss battles are powerful climatic moments that put a player’s abilities to the test. In the Dark Souls series , specifically, from the Asylum Demon to Slave Knight Gael , the Dark Souls bosses are encounters that inspire fear, awe, pity, and wonder.

Bosses also act as progression gates that require a certain level of fluency with the game’s combat system before the player can continue to explore. Once a player reaches a boss gate, they must either muster the skill to defeat that boss, or continue to practice and grind on earlier enemies.

Unlike the average enemy that players must face in a limited area not much wider than a typical hallway, bosses are frequently found in massive arenas. Bosses in the Souls series also tend to have enhanced abilities that require the player to adapt to attacks that cover huge areas or have extended reach. This ferocity and enlarged battlefield gives the designers space to create exciting, multi-phase duels that are unforgettably intense.

These boss fights also act as a check on the player’s build. No matter which weapons or elements a player prefers, massive and powerful bosses require adaptation.

Experienced players understand how each type of stat affects their damage output and they use all of the gear at their disposal to create a move set that fits their style and is powerful enough to take down bosses.

items.title: ELDEN RING - RAGING WOLF 1/6 SCALE STATUE
items.summary: Who is the Raging Wolf? Among the first Tarnished to join the Roundtable Hold was Vargram, a warrior of great skill and ferocity. He acquired the title of the Raging Wolf from the white wolf pelt that flowed from his helm. Vargram sought to
items.content:
Who is the Raging Wolf?

Among the first Tarnished to join the Roundtable Hold was Vargram, a warrior of great skill and ferocity. He acquired the title of the Raging Wolf from the white wolf pelt that flowed from his helm. Vargram sought to become the shadow of one of the Empyreans and built his strength relentlessly as he traveled through fallow Limgrave to the golden city of Leyndell. And yet in spite of all his strength, his armor is now worn by another… An unnamed Tarnished now walks the Lands Between in the skin of the wolf. Does this warrior seek the same fate as Vargram, forever stalking at the side of an Empyrean? Will they uphold the Golden Order or supplant it for some new code? Whatever the destination, woe befall upon any who dare block the path.

The most impressive Elden Ring statue yet

Standing at 33 cm/13 inches, it’s one of the largest character statues ever produced for ELDEN RING. Crafted with the attentive supervision of FromSoftware, this full 1/6 scale figure captures each minute detail with masterful skill. The size allows perfect fidelity to the beautiful and dark fantasy atmosphere of the game, including smears of bloody red across blade of the Bastard Sword and the crest of the Iron Roundshield. From the intricate filigrees of its helm to its whisps of silvered fur blown back by an errant breeze to the humble, dusty cloth wraps protecting the feet of its greaves against the mossy stones of the path to Stoneveil Castle, it’s a portrait of the implacable will of the Tarnished. All these expertly rendered touches from sculpturer Shinya Yamaoka make this statue a perfect match to the most iconic set from one of the most iconic games of this generation.

Where can I get a Raging Wolf Set statue?

Pre-orders for the Raging Wolf 1/6 scale statue can be placed on the official Bandai Namco website. At this time, based on the production estimates of Gecco studio, these stunning PVC/ABS figures will ship to your home in Winter of 2026. If you are a true aficionado of the game, there is no better purchase to bring the world of Elden Ring to your home or office. It’s a timeless piece for your own collection or an impressive gift for a friend or loved one. And one small note, if you have not yet found this set in the Lands Between for your Tarnished, we recommend you seek the aid of Recusant Bernahl at the Volcano Manor.

Place your order for the Raging Wolf statue on the official Bandai Namco Store.

*This product is available on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia, the Middle East, India, and the United States.

items.title: ELDEN RING: SHADOW OF THE ERDTREE – Official Vinyl Soundtrack
items.summary: Follow in the foosteps of Miquella once more with this exclusive 2 disc vinyl collection, celebrating the sweeping, emotional journey of Shadow of the Erdtree. Presented with the reverence merited by a legendary expansion, this premium set
items.content:
Follow in the foosteps of Miquella once more with this exclusive 2 disc vinyl collection, celebrating the sweeping, emotional journey of Shadow of the Erdtree.

Presented with the reverence merited by a legendary expansion, this premium set is crafted for collectors, audiophiles, and Tarnished who seek to experience the Realm of Shadow through its music.

The Collection

Housed in a full color gatefold sleeve and marked with the symbol of Messmer the Impaler, each vinyl disc is pressed on heavyweight material to ensure optimal durability and warmth of playback. Whether displayed proudly on a shelf or played to relive your own quest, this set is designed as both a collector’s piece and a lasting tribute to one of the most celebrated expansions in modern gaming.

The Artists

Across 18 tracks, the soundtrack transforms the ELDEN RING experience into a powerful standalone odyssey—one carried by orchestral grandeur, ethereal choir work, and the signature melancholy that defines the worlds created by FromSoftware.

A Collector’s Treasure

This official vinyl set is an essential centerpiece for any discerning fan’s collection. Perfect for longtime followers of FromSoftware’s musical legacy or newcomers drawn into the Land of Shadow for the first time. *This vinyl is available exclusively on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia, Middle East, India and the United States

items.title: Discover the ELDEN RING Blaidd The Half-Wolf Lamp
items.summary: Summon the legendary warrior into your world with the Blaidd The Half-Wolf Lamp, a handcrafted, LED-powered tribute to one of ELDEN RING ’s most iconic character. Designed for collectors, lore enthusiasts, and Tarnished alike, this unique n
items.content:
Summon the legendary warrior into your world with the Blaidd The Half-Wolf Lamp, a handcrafted, LED-powered tribute to one of ELDEN RING’s most iconic character.

Designed for collectors, lore enthusiasts, and Tarnished alike, this unique night lamp captures the tragic loyalty and silent strength of Blaidd, Shadow of Ranni.

The lamp features an LED-illuminated base that reveals glowing rune symbols beneath Blaidd’s feet, evoking the grace-given power that guides Tarnished across the Lands Between. Rising above it, an engraved acrylic summoning panel glows softly when lit, capturing the look and feel of an in-game summon sign and the spirit-calling magic it represents. Powered through a simple USB connection, it offers effortless illumination for any desk, gaming setup, or collector’s display.

"If ever thou shouldst call upon me… I shall come."

Blaidd’s oath echoes still. Now, he stands ready, not for battle, but as a silent guardian of your space.

Bring the moonlit magic of ELDEN RING into your world, one glowing rune at a time.

*This edition is available exclusively on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia and the United States.
